annotations.title: Ask a licensed agent to contact me

description: Send the person's contact request to a licensed Via Rapida agent, who will call, text or email back (usually same business day). Only call this after the person explicitly asks to be contacted and confirms the details. Returns a reference code (VR-XXXXXX) the person can use with get_quote_status. Never include SSN, driver's license, bank or card numbers.

consent_to_contact.description: Set true only after showing the person this text and getting a yes: 'Via Rapida Services / Insurance City (CA Insurance License #6003045) may call, text or email you at the phone and email you gave, about this request. Message and data rates may apply; reply STOP to any text to opt out. Agreeing is not required to buy anything.' ES: 'Via Rapida Services / Insurance City (Licencia de Seguros de California #6003045) puede llamarle, enviarle textos o correos al teléfono y correo que nos dio, sobre esta solicitud. Pueden aplicar cargos por mensajes y datos; responda STOP a cualquier texto para no recibir más. Aceptar no es requisito para comprar.'

notes.description: Short description: vehicles, current carrier/expiration, business type. No SSN/DL/bank/card numbers.

phone.description: US phone number (phone or email required)
